summary.en: To drive abroad with a Japanese licence, apply for an international driving permit. Apply to the Public Safety Commission for your address, with a document showing that you are travelling abroad. It is valid for 1 year from the date of issue. Holders of only a moped, small special or provisional licence cannot apply (to be checked). This is a different procedure from converting a foreign licence to a Japanese one. Check the place, hours, fee and photo on the Aichi Prefectural Police page (to be checked).

text.en: Bring: the application form and a document showing you are travelling abroad (such as a passport). Check the photo and fee on the Aichi Prefectural Police page (to be checked).

evidence.quote: 国外運転免許証の有効期間は、当該国外運転免許証の発給の日から起算して一年とする。
